passage.label: So remind Muhammad only reminder; not over them controller; However turns away disbelieves; Then Allah punish greatest punishment; Indeed Us return; Then indeed upon Us account

mainSubject.label: The Prophet instructed to remind since he is only a reminder and not a controller over them; whoever turns away and disbelieves will be punished by Allah with the greatest punishment; their return is to Him and upon Him rests their account

subordinateSubjects.label: So remind O Muhammad — you are only a reminder
You are not over them a controller
However whoever turns away and disbelieves
Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment
Indeed to Us is their return
Then indeed upon Us is their account

commandsAndProhibitions.description: So remind — you are only a reminder.
You are not over them a controller.

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Turning away and disbelief answered by the greatest punishment

relationships.label: Return to Allah and accounting by Him as the closing framework

notes: Wave 12 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the non-nourishing thorny plant verdict (7) before the pleased-faces block opens (8); P2 ends with the carpet-spreading furnishing detail (16) before the four-fold observational challenge begins (17); P3 covers the camel-sky-mountain-earth signs (17-20); P4 runs through the reminder-only role, the turning-away warning and the closing return-and-account declaration (21-26).
